registered_findings.statement: The approved snapshot documents 12 total leads in aggregated form.
The approved snapshot shows a stage split of 3 new leads and 9 qualifying leads.
The approved snapshot supports a documentary hypothesis of concentration in the intermediate qualifying stage.
The snapshot indicates low top-of-funnel representation relative to qualifying, limiting visibility into replenishment of new leads.
The approved evidence is a single aggregate snapshot and does not establish trend continuity by itself.
The approved chain does not anchor live CRM and all findings remain historical and snapshot-bound.
Future documentary monitoring should stay focused on aggregate stage counts and the balance between new and qualifying.
